facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs' Draft Revised White Paper proposes turning the National Population Register into an Intelligent Population Register as the foundation for a Digital ID system, with births and deaths registered digitally.

systems.platform: proposed upgrade of the National Population Register

ZAF.note: Digital birth and death registration is only proposed in a draft white paper.
A white paper on citizenship and immigration, not a national digital strategy; a Digital ID policy is only under development.

facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Leon Schreiber published the Draft Revised White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for public comment from 12 December 2025 to 31 January 2026, available on the Department's website with written comments accepted by email.

facts.fact: South Africa's existing National Population Register records basic information including names, births and deaths, per the Department of Home Affairs.
The National Population Register records births and deaths, and the white paper would add mandatory birth and death registration through digital channels.
